answer: Rather than prove who you are, the network asks what you can still produce, on a seeded nectar that changes every epoch. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the juniper of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. What cannot be bought is a jury that already trusts you. Each echo has to be earned inside a panel system that prices collusion at the loss of every seat granted. Seal 1oyg9.
